_doc: Stored library-vs-online-planning validation states of the three shipped grasp libraries. Each row is [target cell, occupancy of the OTHER cells as a hex bitmask over the library's 'bits' order, verdict of online planning (true = a collision-free pick/put motion was found in that very scene)]. Derived without re-running anything from the validation outputs written when the libraries were built; see scripts/libraries/README.md.
